scope: Bind selected candidate value sequences for all 66 existing raw-only FIELD records in the exact AutoCAD 2007 metric source, using its ODA DXF, ACadSharp output and decompressed frame bit walker.

acadsharp.runtime: .NET 11, DOTNET_ROLL_FORWARD=Major; scratch probe adapted to include AcObjProp, AcObjProp.16.2 and AcSm.

proof.scope: decompressed object-local bits and peer output, not native behavior

findings: The previously checked 42 records remain matched; the remaining 24 produce 58 peer-matched candidate type-4 value sequences: 14 AcObjProp.16.2 unknown-root fields with two strings each, one AcObjProp.16.2 string-root field with three, and nine AcSm string-root fields with three.

Each candidate contains the peer-matched flags/type, BL byte count, NUL-terminated UTF-16LE bytes and following BL zero within the bounded body. Candidate sequences are selected only when their source order and final body boundary yield a unique solution; duplicated strings are disambiguated by the complete ordered sequence.

For the 24 records, the selected peer owner equals the previous handle and matches the physical relative-owner token; the bounded handle tail has no additional token. ODA and ACadSharp agree on each selected string.

In 0x3AAF0, ?BlockRefId occupies bits 237..429 and UpdatedDistance occupies 453..709; the matched units end at bits 431 and 711. This explains why the earlier current/libredwg cursor at bit 237 encounters text bytes instead of the next child flags.
In 0x3AABD, the peer-matched root Window Width starts at bit 147 and the two child strings at bits 423 and 639; the last unit ends at the body boundary bit 897.
The remaining 24 are all observed in one identified producer profile; the findings bind these selected sequences and owner tails, not every body field or complete native evaluator behavior.
validation: The checker refuses flags, length, payload and owner-role mutations and a changed ACadSharp value; the earlier 42-record invocation remains valid.
No DWG or DXF fixture was committed.
authorityConflict: ODA v5.4.1 sections 2, 20.1, 20.4.76 and 20.4.99 require R2007+ TV/TU strings in the object string stream; the observed byte sequences occur in the body. Under repository instructions the authoritative rule wins. These peer comparisons do not permit adding an inline-string parser or promoting a support claim.
nextStep: Seek an authoritative versioned clarification or a verified lossless opaque representation; independently bind all intervening body fields, strings, handles and following-object boundaries before any FIELD parser/output admission. Preserve strict refusal and atomic retry.
limitations: Two peer implementations interpret the same original sample; they do not establish native AutoCAD evaluation or lossless round-trip.
Ordering and end-boundary matching do not prove the meaning of the intervening bits, all field values, every reference, or a general FIELD layout.
The source is one AutoCAD 2007 metric drawing, and no additional producer/platform profile is claimed.
